canonical_title: Emergency control marking of functional groups

versions.title_at_revision: Emergency control marking of functional groups
versions.text:
Standard: Panels with functional groups involving emergency or critical controls should be outlined with a 5mm (0.1875in) red border, IAW paint color 21136 of AMS-STD-595. Alternatively, functional groups of emergency controls may be designated by contrasting color pads or patches for critical and non-critical functional areas. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review drawings to verify that emergency controls are properly marked.
(2) Examine the air vehicle and verify that emergency controls are properly marked.
